topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, I’ll be! The ol’ paths of life do cross in strange ways, don’t they? I never thought back when I was younger, sitting there in Master Baldwin’s class, that my little Ella would be under his care too. He was a strict one, mind you, but fair. Always made sure we knew our letters and numbers, and a bit of the saints thrown in for good measure. I remember one harvest, he showed me how to count the sheaves just right, and I’ll never forget it. Now, seeing Ella come back from her first day, all excited about the lessons and tales, it feels like the soil has turned full circle, rich and ready for planting again. It’s a good sign, I reckon, a good sign indeed.
